codeql_build_command: cd /src/skia && (timeout 600 python3 tools/git-sync-deps 2>&1 | tail -5) || true; find src/core src/utils src/codec src/image src/effects src/ports -maxdepth 4 -name '*.cpp' 2>/dev/null | head -200 | xargs -P 4 -I {} sh -c 'clang++ -c -std=c++17 -DSK_GANESH=0 -DSK_GRAPHITE=0 -I . -I include -I include/core -I include/private -I include/private/base -I include/utils -I include/codec -I include/effects -I include/encode -I include/ports -I src -I src/base -I src/core -I modules "{}" -o /tmp/$(basename "{}").o' 2>/dev/null || true
